correctness.rationale: TARGET route: audited the exact headline inequality as defined. Lemma 1 verified: antiderivative F(u)=-1/u+1/u^2-1/(3u^3) differentiates to (u-1)^2/u^4, giving E[Y^2]=1/2, E[X^2]=1, and tail P(|X|>t)=(1/2)(1+t/sqrt2)^-3=(1+o(1))sqrt2 t^-3. Lemma 2 verified: m=-1+s gives s^2+eps*s-eps=0, |s|^2<=|eps|(1+|s|), and |eps|<=1/25 forces |s|<=0.283, |m|^4>0.26>1/4. Truncated-moment identity T(M)=6[G(U)-G(1)] verified by substitution u=1+x/sqrt2 (re-derived independently); hand lower bound T(M)>=2.43(M-10) verified from 1.41<sqrt2<1.42 only (prefactor 3/(2 sqrt2)>1.05, (1/0.81)^4>2.32; independent numeric check gives min integrand ~2.50 on [10,100]). kappa_N>=T-3 uses E[(X^<=)^2]<=1, valid. Headline at N=1e12 (M=100): kappa>=215.7, |L|>=53.9>=(1/8)ln N=3.45, with gap g(N) monotone increasing thereafter (g'=N^-1(0.405 N^{1/6}-0.5)>0). N0(w)=max(1e12,(25|w|)^{3/2}) correctly combines both requirements. GOE contrast correct: Gaussian cumulants above order 2 vanish so literal functional is 0; truncated analogue bounded. Draft honestly scopes L_N as the normalized fourth-cumulant monomial with absolute combinatorial prefactor absorbed and disclaims full-expansion convergence and any TW rate, so no overclaim. verify_target.py re-run prints ALL_VERIFY_OK. Distinguishes proof (hand lemmas) from numerical cross-check (not load-bearing).

originality.rationale: Live fused search over three normalized forms (literal divergent-loop headline; equivalent cumulant/Schwinger-Dyson/truncated-moment/tail-exponent-3/density wordings; dominance/broader census query) plus direct fetch of decisive priors finds no source stating or implying the explicit inequality |kappa_N m_sc^4|>=1/8 log N for the named normalized density p(y)=(3/4)(1+|y|)^-4, X=sqrt2 Y, at z_N=2+wN^{-2/3}. Lee-Yin (arXiv:1206.2251) gives qualitative TW criterion s^4P->0 which E3 violates (s^4P~sqrt2 s->inf) but states no loop-term rate. Auffinger-Ben Arous-Peche (arXiv:0710.3132) and Soshnikov give qualitative Poisson limits with no resolvent-monomial inequality. Schnelli-Xu TW rates assume finite moments (bounded errors, opposite regime); Borot-Nadal loop equations are Gaussian beta-ensemble. See decisive_checks for adversarial coverage tests. Google provider reported 'database is locked' on all three queries (partial coverage recorded); OpenAlex/Crossref returned only irrelevant hits, and decisive priors were verified by direct fetch, so no single-source failure establishes priority.

value.rationale: TARGET claim completed exactly as admitted (c0=1/8, N0(w), GOE O(1) contrast); no preset-fallback presumption needed and none applied. The result is an independently retrievable exact breakdown witness for a natural object at a natural scale: alpha=3 is the canonical midpoint of the finite-variance infinite-fourth-moment window (2,4), the symmetric Pareto density is the standard textbook power law, and N^{-2/3} is the TW edge scale. The value (log-floor divergence, in fact ~N^{1/6} vs GOE O(1)) was not known or mechanically implied by qualitative Poisson/TW-criterion literature and is reusable as an edge-robustness diagnostic for Levy/band matrices and a benchmark reference. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; limitations (no full expansion convergence, no TW rate, crude N0) are stated honestly.

L_N absorbs an absolute combinatorial prefactor of the standard cumulant expansion; the true k=3 loop term equals a nonzero absolute constant times kappa_N m_sc^4, so log-divergence is preserved but the literal prefactor differs by that constant.
'log N' is the natural logarithm (headline margin 53.9 vs 3.45 at N=1e12 makes the base immaterial, but future citation should state ln).
N0=1e12 is deliberately crude; the bound holds with huge room (true growth ~N^{1/6}) and is not tuned.
No claim is made about full loop-expansion convergence for E3 or any Tracy-Widom rate; the certified consequence is strictly the blocking of bounded-fourth-cumulant comparison routes.
